description: An invariant reaching a constant through a `fn` chain, where a server function reaches the same constant through a call (`srv` → `key` → K): E-DECL-INVARIANT-IMPURE (the constant is server-read; reading it in a check the client runs would ship it). The set refused through a call is the set refused directly.
rationale: Ruling S483-invariant-const-read: "A `let`, a host-derived const, or a server-only const stays refused." §66.13.5 rule 7: "The set refused through a call is exactly the set refused directly."
